name: Barbell Prone Incline Curl
breathing_cue: Exhale curling up
coaching_cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging
Curl without swinging, squeeze at the top
Lower slowly to full extension
common_mistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench to cheat
pro_tip: Use an EZ bar if straight-bar curls hurt the wrists.

name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
breathing_cue: Exhale curling up
coaching_cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging
Curl without swinging, squeeze at the top
Lower slowly to full extension
common_mistakes: Lifting the chest off the bench to cheat
pro_tip: A 45-degree bench keeps the arms in line with the body.

name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Shrug
breathing_cue: Exhale shrugging up
coaching_cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging
Shrug the shoulder blades up and back
Lower slowly to a full stretch
common_mistakes: Bending the elbows to lift the weight
pro_tip: Hold the top for one second.

name: Side Wrist Pull Stretch
breathing_cue: Slow deep breaths; exhale to ease deeper
coaching_cues: Extend one arm, palm facing out
Gently pull the fingers back with the other hand
Hold with the elbow straight
common_mistakes: Pulling too hard on the wrist
pro_tip: Do both palm-up and palm-down versions.

name: Band Pull Through
breathing_cue: Inhale hinging back, exhale driving hips forward
coaching_cues: Face away from the anchor, hinge at the hips
Push the hips back until the hamstrings stretch
Drive hips forward and squeeze the glutes
pro_tip: Keep arms passive; the hips do the work.

name: Assisted Pull Up
breathing_cue: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering
coaching_cues: Start from a full hang, shoulders pulled down
Drive the elbows down toward the hips
Chin over the bar, lower fully controlled
common_mistakes: Stopping short of a full hang
pro_tip: Reduce the assist weight each week.

name: Band Assisted Pull Up
breathing_cue: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering
coaching_cues: Start from a full hang, shoulders pulled down
Drive the elbows down toward the hips
Chin over the bar, lower fully controlled
common_mistakes: Stopping short of a full hang
pro_tip: Use thinner bands as you get stronger.

name: Parallel Close Grip Pull Up
breathing_cue: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering
coaching_cues: Neutral close grip on parallel handles, full hang
Pull the chest up to the hands
Lower fully controlled
common_mistakes: Stopping short of a full hang
pro_tip: Pull the elbows to your pockets, not the chin to the bar.

name: Scapular Pull Up
breathing_cue: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering
coaching_cues: Hang from the bar with straight arms
Pull the shoulder blades down without bending the elbows
Return to a full hang slowly
pro_tip: Do these before every pull-up session.

name: Standing Assisted Pull Up

coaching_cues: Stand on the assist platform and grip the handles, palms facing away
Drive the elbows down toward the hips, chest up
Lower slowly, fully extending the arms
common_mistakes: Letting the assist do the whole rep
Stopping short of full arm extension
pro_tip: Use less assistance each week until you can do unassisted reps.

name: Wide Grip Pull Up
breathing_cue: Exhale pulling up, inhale lowering
coaching_cues: Grip wider than the shoulders, full hang
Pull the elbows down and out toward the ribs
Chin over the bar, lower fully controlled
common_mistakes: Stopping short of a full hang
pro_tip: Pull the elbows to your pockets, not the chin to the bar.

name: Band Close Grip Pulldown
breathing_cue: Exhale as you pull down, inhale as you return
coaching_cues: Anchor the band high, sit or kneel tall
Pull the elbows down to your ribs
Control the band back up to full stretch
common_mistakes: Leaning back and yanking with the arms

name: Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown

common_mistakes: Leaning back and yanking with the arms

Pulling the bar behind the neck

name: Cable Single Arm Pulldown

pro_tip: Light weight and slow reps; this is for shoulder health.

Keep the hips and shoulders square
Hold still and breathe slowly
common_mistakes: Holding the breath and tensing up
pro_tip: Relax a little more on every exhale.

name: Shoulder Tap

Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder
Keep the hips level and still as you alternate

pro_tip: Hold the top for one second; no neck craning.

Pause at the top and lower under control

name: 45 Degree Side Bend
breathing_cue: Exhale as you bend to the side, inhale as you return
coaching_cues: Stand tall, hips square, weight in one hand
Bend sideways from the waist, no twisting
Return to upright using the obliques
common_mistakes: Using too much weight and swinging
pro_tip: Keep the load moderate; high reps with control.
indian_alternative: Side bends holding a loaded bag

name: Cable Side Bend
breathing_cue: Exhale as you bend to the side, inhale as you return

Bend sideways from the waist, no twisting
Return to upright using the obliques
common_mistakes: Using too much weight and swinging
pro_tip: Keep the load moderate; high reps with control.
indian_alternative: Side bends holding a loaded bag

name: Cable Side Crunch
breathing_cue: Exhale as you crunch sideways
coaching_cues: Stand side-on to a high cable, handle at shoulder height
Crunch sideways, bringing ribs toward the hip
Return slowly without leaning back
common_mistakes: Using the arm to pull instead of the obliques
Rotating the torso instead of bending sideways
pro_tip: Keep hips still so the trunk does all the movement.

name: Wall Seated Side Crunch
breathing_cue: Exhale as you crunch sideways
coaching_cues: Back against the wall, thighs parallel in a wall sit
Crunch one elbow toward the same-side knee
Hold the wall sit position the whole set
common_mistakes: Sliding up out of the wall sit
Pulling on the neck with the hands
pro_tip: Pause one second at the top of each crunch.

name: Bodyweight Incline Side Plank
breathing_cue: Breathe slowly and steadily throughout the hold
coaching_cues: Hand or forearm on a bench, body in one straight line
Lift the hips high, stack the feet
Squeeze the obliques to stay level
pro_tip: Higher surface = easier; lower it as you get stronger.

name: Push Up to Side Plank
breathing_cue: Exhale as you push up and rotate
coaching_cues: Lower into a push up, chest to the floor
Press up and rotate into a side plank, arm reaching up
Return to the push up and alternate sides
common_mistakes: Rushing the rotation and losing balance
pro_tip: Widen your feet to make the rotation easier.

name: Dumbbell Alternate Side Press
breathing_cue: Exhale as the arm presses up
coaching_cues: Dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward
Press one arm overhead while the other lowers
Keep ribs down and the torso still
common_mistakes: Leaning sideways to finish the press
Flaring the elbows far behind the body
pro_tip: Treat it as an alternating dumbbell press.

name: Neck Side Stretch
breathing_cue: Breathe slowly and steadily; exhale to ease deeper
coaching_cues: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed down
Tilt the ear toward the shoulder, no forcing
Hold, breathe, then switch sides
common_mistakes: Lifting the shoulder up to meet the ear
Yanking the head with the hand
pro_tip: Reach the opposite hand toward the floor for a deeper stretch.

name: Weighted Sissy Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Hold a plate at the chest and a post for balance
Lean back, knees travelling forward
Drive up with the quads
pro_tip: Master bodyweight sissy squats first.

name: Arms Overhead Full Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie on your back, arms extended overhead
Swing the arms up as you curl to sitting
Lower slowly, arms back overhead
common_mistakes: Yanking the neck with the hands
pro_tip: Keep arms overhead; that lever makes it harder.

name: Band Jack Knife Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie back with a band looped round your ankles, anchored past your feet
Sit up and bring knees to chest together
Lower with control against the band
common_mistakes: Letting the band yank you back
Swinging the legs instead of using the abs
pro_tip: Anchor the band low and past your feet.

name: Band Push Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie back with an anchored band held at the chest
Sit up while pressing the band forward
Lower under control, keep tension on the band
pro_tip: Press at the top of the sit up to add shoulder work.

name: Barbell Press Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie back holding a light barbell above the chest
Sit up while pressing the bar overhead
Lower the bar and torso together
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top
pro_tip: A very light bar is plenty here.

name: Decline Twisting Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Hook feet under a decline bench pad
Sit up and twist the elbow toward the opposite knee
Lower slowly and alternate sides
pro_tip: Cross the arms over the chest to stay honest.

name: Half Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat
Curl up smoothly, leading with the chest
Lower under control
Keep the lower back from flailing
common_mistakes: Yanking the neck with the hands
pro_tip: Stop halfway up; keep the lower back on the floor.

name: Jackknife Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie back with arms overhead and legs straight
Raise arms and legs together to meet over the hips
Lower with control, do not slam down
common_mistakes: Bending the knees to cheat the reach
pro_tip: Reach the hands to the toes at the top.

name: Prisoner Half Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Hands behind the head, elbows wide
Curl up halfway, keep the chin off the chest
Lower under control
pro_tip: Think elbows wide, ribs to hips.

name: Quarter Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat
Curl up smoothly, leading with the chest
Lower under control
Keep the lower back from flailing
common_mistakes: Yanking the neck with the hands
pro_tip: Small range, constant tension.

name: Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat
Curl all the way up until the chest meets the thighs
Lower with control
common_mistakes: Yanking the neck with the hands
pro_tip: Anchor the feet under a sofa if they lift.

name: Three Quarter Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat
Curl up smoothly, leading with the chest
Lower under control
Keep the lower back from flailing
common_mistakes: Yanking the neck with the hands
pro_tip: Stop just short of sitting fully upright.

name: Weighted Decline Sit Up
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Hook the feet under the decline pad, plate at arm length over the chest
Sit up with control, plate stays over the chest
Lower slowly
common_mistakes: Using a plate that is too heavy
pro_tip: Keep the plate over the chest and the arms long, not behind the head.

name: Skater Hops
breathing_cue: Exhale on each push-off
coaching_cues: Bound sideways off one leg, land on the other
Sweep the trailing leg behind, arms swing across
Stick each landing softly before the next hop
pro_tip: Stick the landing for a beat to build control.

name: Ski Ergometer (Time)
breathing_cue: Breathe rhythmically; settle into a pace you can sustain
coaching_cues: Hinge and pull the handles down to the thighs
Drive with legs and lats together, not arms alone
Recover smoothly up to the start
pro_tip: Keep the pace steady; pull hard, recover slowly.

name: Barbell Decline Close Grip to Skull Press
breathing_cue: Inhale lowering, exhale pressing
coaching_cues: Decline bench, hands shoulder-width, bar over chest
Lower toward the forehead, elbows pointing forward
Press back up to the start, locking out smoothly
common_mistakes: Dropping the bar too fast near the face
pro_tip: Use a spotter and a bar you can control.

name: Barbell Reverse Grip Skullcrusher
breathing_cue: Inhale lowering, exhale extending
coaching_cues: Lie back, upper arms fixed and angled slightly back
Lower the weight toward the forehead by bending only the elbows
Extend the elbows to press back up
common_mistakes: Using a weight that forces the shoulders to help
pro_tip: The underhand grip changes wrist angle; keep the load light.

name: Barbell Single Arm Snatch
breathing_cue: Big breath and brace before the pull, exhale after the catch
coaching_cues: Start with the bar close, back flat
Extend hips and knees powerfully to launch the bar
Catch or finish with the bar tight to the body
common_mistakes: Letting the bar swing away from the body
pro_tip: Learn with a PVC pipe or empty bar before adding load.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Snatch
breathing_cue: Big breath and brace before the pull, exhale after the catch
coaching_cues: Dumbbell between the feet, hinge with a flat back
Drive hips up and pull the DB overhead in one motion
Lock out overhead, lower under control
common_mistakes: Curling the dumbbell instead of pulling with the hips
pro_tip: Think of jumping the dumbbell up, not lifting it.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Snatch
breathing_cue: Big breath and brace before the pull, exhale after the catch
coaching_cues: Swing the bell back between the legs, hinge deep
Snap the hips and punch the hand through at the top
Lock out overhead, bell soft on the forearm
common_mistakes: Pulling with the arm and lower back
Slamming the bell onto the wrist
pro_tip: Learn the swing and clean first.

name: Snatch Pull
breathing_cue: Big breath and brace before the pull, exhale after the catch
coaching_cues: Wide snatch grip, back flat, bar over the feet
Push the floor away, extend hips and knees fully
Shrug at the top, do not let the bar drift
common_mistakes: Pulling with the arms too early
pro_tip: Pause at the knee once to groove the position.

name: Spanish Squat
breathing_cue: Breathe steadily; do not hold your breath
coaching_cues: Band behind the knees, anchored to a post in front
Lean back into the band with a vertical shin
Sit down and hold, quads doing the work
common_mistakes: Anchoring the band to something that slips
pro_tip: Quad-focused and knee-friendly; use a thick band.

name: Barbell Speed Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace at the top, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Light bar on the upper back, brace hard
Drop fast under control, then explode up
Reset between reps, every rep crisp
common_mistakes: Loading too heavy so the speed disappears
pro_tip: Use about half your max and move the bar fast.

name: Sphinx
breathing_cue: Breathe slowly and steadily; exhale to ease deeper
coaching_cues: Lie face down, forearms flat, elbows under shoulders
Press the chest up, hips staying on the floor
Relax the glutes and breathe
common_mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears
Forcing the back into a pinch
pro_tip: Stop if you feel pinching in the lower back.

name: Spine Stretch
breathing_cue: Breathe slowly and steadily; exhale to ease deeper
coaching_cues: Sit tall with legs apart, arms reaching forward
Curl the spine forward from the head down
Roll back up slowly, stacking the spine
pro_tip: Imagine bending over a large ball.

name: Spine Twist
breathing_cue: Breathe slowly and steadily; exhale to ease deeper
coaching_cues: Sit tall, arms out to the sides
Rotate the trunk, leading with the chest
Return to centre and switch sides
common_mistakes: Twisting from the lower back only
pro_tip: Sit on a folded towel if the hips are tight.

name: Band Single Leg Split Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Rear foot raised, band under the front foot and over the shoulders
Lower the back knee toward the floor
Drive up through the front heel
common_mistakes: Rear foot too high so the hips tilt
pro_tip: Use a chair for the back foot.

name: Barbell Single Leg Split Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace at the top, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Bar on the upper back, rear foot raised on a bench
Lower until the front thigh is parallel
Drive up through the front heel
common_mistakes: Torso collapsing forward under the bar
pro_tip: Use a rack and set the safety pins.

name: Smith Single Leg Split Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Bar on the upper back, rear foot on a bench behind
Lower until the front thigh is parallel
Drive up through the front heel
common_mistakes: Front foot too close to the bar line
pro_tip: Set the front foot slightly forward of the bar.

name: Barbell Single Leg Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace at the top, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Bar on the upper back, one foot planted
Sit back and down on the working leg
Stand using the whole foot, torso steady
common_mistakes: Losing balance and twisting under the bar
pro_tip: Perfect the bodyweight version first.

name: Barbell Wide Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace at the top, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Bar on the upper back, feet wider than shoulders, toes out
Sit straight down between the hips
Drive up, pushing the knees out
common_mistakes: Heels lifting or chest dropping forward
pro_tip: Turn the toes out to match the knee track.

name: Bodyweight Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Sit back and down, chest tall
Drive through the mid-foot to stand
common_mistakes: Heels lifting or chest dropping forward
pro_tip: Reach the arms forward for balance.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Hold a dumbbell at your side, stand on one leg
Sit back and down, free leg out front
Stand without letting the knee cave
pro_tip: Use a box to touch down until balance is solid.

name: Dumbbell Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Brace your core and keep the chest tall
Sit down between the hips, knees tracking over toes
Drive up through the mid-foot
common_mistakes: Heels lifting or chest dropping forward
pro_tip: Hold dumbbells at the sides or at the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Supported Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Hold a dumbbell at the chest and sit back onto the seat behind you
Sit back and down, chest tall
Drive up through the mid-foot
common_mistakes: Heels lifting or chest dropping forward
pro_tip: Use the support to balance, not to pull yourself up.

name: Lever Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Hold the handles at your sides, feet shoulder-width
Lower under control until the thighs are parallel
Press through the mid-foot to stand
pro_tip: Set the start position so you begin standing tall.

name: Lying Squat
breathing_cue: Exhale as the legs press
coaching_cues: Lie back on the pad with both feet flat on the plate
Press the legs out and back in with control
Keep the lower back flat on the pad
common_mistakes: Letting the lower back lift off the pad
pro_tip: Start light and slow until the range feels smooth.

name: Single Leg Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Stand on one leg, arms forward for balance
Sit back and down, free leg held out
Stand tall without the knee caving
pro_tip: Hold a post or sit to a bench to regress it.

name: Smith Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace down, exhale up
coaching_cues: Bar across the upper back, feet slightly forward of the bar
Sit back and down to parallel
Drive up through the mid-foot
common_mistakes: Feet directly under the bar so the knees jam
pro_tip: Feet slightly in front of the bar keeps the knees happy.

name: Squat Jerk
breathing_cue: Big breath and brace before the pull, exhale after the catch
coaching_cues: Bar on the front rack, dip straight down and drive
Punch the bar up and drop under it into a squat
Stand with the bar locked out overhead
common_mistakes: Letting the bar swing away from the body
pro_tip: Learn with a light bar and a coach.

name: Semi Squat Jump
breathing_cue: Exhale on take-off
coaching_cues: Quarter squat with the arms back
Jump up, swinging the arms forward
Land softly back in the quarter squat
pro_tip: Land quietly; if it is loud, jump lower.

name: Band Squat Row
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale as you stand and row
coaching_cues: Anchor the band in front at chest height
Squat down, arms straight
Stand and row the handles to the ribs
common_mistakes: Rowing before the legs finish standing
pro_tip: Pick a band that you can row without leaning back.

name: Stairmaster (Time)
breathing_cue: Breathe rhythmically; settle into a pace you can sustain
coaching_cues: Stand tall, light touch on the rails
Step through the full foot, driving through the heel
Keep a steady cadence
pro_tip: Let go of the rails as soon as you can.

name: Stalder Press
breathing_cue: Hold a steady breath through the press
coaching_cues: Start from a straddle-seat (L-sit) with hands on the floor
Pike the hips high and press the legs through the arms
Rise to handstand with straight arms
pro_tip: Work straddle press and pike compression first.

name: Barbell Narrow Stance Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace at the top, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Bar on the upper back, feet close together
Sit straight down, knees forward over the toes
Drive up through the mid-foot
common_mistakes: Heels lifting or chest dropping forward
pro_tip: Narrow stance puts more load on the quads; use lighter loads.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift with Stepbox Support
breathing_cue: Inhale down, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Rest the free toes on the step box behind you
Hinge on the standing leg, back flat, dumbbell down
Drive the hips forward to stand
pro_tip: Lightly rest the back toe; the standing leg does the work.

name: Band Stepup
breathing_cue: Exhale as you step up
coaching_cues: Stand on the band, hold the handles at the shoulders
Step up, driving through the front heel
Lower slowly back down
pro_tip: Use a step height where the thigh is about parallel.

name: Barbell Stepup
breathing_cue: Exhale as you step up
coaching_cues: Bar on the upper back, front foot on the box
Drive through the front heel to stand
Lower with control
pro_tip: Set a box that keeps the working thigh near parallel.

name: Dumbbell Stepup Lunge
breathing_cue: Exhale as you step up
coaching_cues: Dumbbells at your sides, front foot on the box
Step up and stand tall
Step back into a lunge, then repeat
pro_tip: Keep the front shin steady; do not hop between reps.

name: Band Stiff Leg Deadlift
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace as you hinge down, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Stand tall, soft knees
Hinge at the hips, back flat, weight loaded
Drive the hips forward to stand
common_mistakes: Bending the knees so it becomes a squat
pro_tip: Stand on the band; the tension peaks at lockout.

name: Band Straight Back Stiff Leg Deadlift
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace as you hinge down, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Stand tall, soft knees
Hinge at the hips, back flat, weight loaded
Drive the hips forward to stand
common_mistakes: Bending the knees so it becomes a squat
pro_tip: Keep the spine long, like a flat tabletop.

name: Dumbbell Stiff Leg Deadlift
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace as you hinge down, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Stand tall, soft knees
Hinge at the hips, back flat, weight loaded
Drive the hips forward to stand
common_mistakes: Bending the knees so it becomes a squat
pro_tip: Let the dumbbells slide close to the legs.

name: Straddle Planche
breathing_cue: Brace and hold steady breaths
coaching_cues: Lean forward over the hands with straight arms
Lift the legs, straddled, to horizontal
Push the floor away and hold
pro_tip: Use parallettes if wrists are tight.

name: Band Straight Leg Deadlift
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace as you hinge down, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Stand tall, soft knees
Hinge at the hips, back flat, weight loaded
Drive the hips forward to stand
common_mistakes: Bending the knees so it becomes a squat
pro_tip: Stand on the band and keep it close to the shins.

name: Barbell Straight Leg Deadlift
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace as you hinge down, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Bar in front of thighs, legs nearly straight
Hinge, sliding the bar down the shins
Drive the hips forward to stand
pro_tip: Lower only until the hamstrings are stretched.

name: Dumbbell Straight Leg Deadlift
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace as you hinge down, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Stand tall, soft knees
Hinge at the hips, back flat, weight loaded
Drive the hips forward to stand
common_mistakes: Bending the knees so it becomes a squat
pro_tip: Let the dumbbells slide close to the legs.

name: Band Lying Straight Leg Raise
breathing_cue: Exhale as you come up, inhale as you lower
coaching_cues: Lie on your back with a band around the feet
Raise straight legs to vertical against the band
Lower slowly, lower back pressed down
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back off the floor
pro_tip: Press the lower back down and keep it there.

name: Short Stride Run (Time)
breathing_cue: Breathe rhythmically; settle into a pace you can sustain
coaching_cues: Run with short, quick steps, landing under the hips
Keep a tall posture and relaxed shoulders
Hold a rhythm you can breathe through
common_mistakes: Over-striding and landing on the heels
pro_tip: Aim for quick light steps, around 170 steps a minute.

name: Smith Sumo Squat
breathing_cue: Inhale and brace at the top, exhale as you stand
coaching_cues: Wide stance under the bar, toes pointed out
Sit straight down between the hips
Drive up, pushing the knees out
pro_tip: Set the feet slightly in front of the bar line.

name: Suspended Row
breathing_cue: Exhale as you pull
coaching_cues: Hold the handles, body straight, heels on the floor
Pull the chest to the hands, squeezing the shoulder blades
Lower slowly until the arms are straight
common_mistakes: Shrugging instead of pulling the shoulder blades back
pro_tip: Walk the feet forward to make it harder.

name: Landmine T-Bar Row
breathing_cue: Exhale as you pull
coaching_cues: Straddle the bar, hinge with a flat back
Pull the handle to the lower chest
Lower under control, no rounding
common_mistakes: Jerking the weight up with the hips
pro_tip: Wedge the bar end in a corner if you have no landmine.

name: Dumbbell Incline T-raise
breathing_cue: Exhale as you lift
coaching_cues: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, dumbbells hanging
Raise arms out to the sides to form a T
Squeeze the shoulder blades, lower slowly
pro_tip: Light weights with a one-second pause at the top.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
breathing_cue: Inhale lowering, exhale extending
coaching_cues: Lie back with dumbbells over the chest, palms facing in
